rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Grandiflora.
Registration name: STARqueli
Exhibition name: Magic Lantern
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Rene Royon (France, before 1993).
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 1994.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. Flowers copper-orange-gold. Mild to strong fragrance. 35 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, high-centered, reflexed bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, upright, well-branched. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 4'11" to 6' (150 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, garden or specimen. Hardy. heat tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
